title: IP Protection in the Era of Visual Generative AI: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2608.14730v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid evolution of visual generative AI has introduced a wide range of intellectual property risks, spanning the unauthorized learning, reproduction, extraction, misuse, and redistribution of protected data and model assets. To address these risks, a growing body of technical defenses has been proposed. However, existing surveys typically organize this literature by lifecycle stage or technical mechanism, which can obscure the protective intent of different methods. This survey presents a two-dimensional taxonomy for IP protection in visual generative models. The primary axis is a Control Logic View, which classifies methods into Information Exposure Control, Generative Behavior Constraint, and Attribution & Accountability according to the risk variable they regulate. The secondary axis distinguishes Data IP from Model IP as cross-cutting asset dimensions. Under this framework, we systematically review protection methods, align eva

translated_title: 视觉生成式人工智能时代的知识产权保护：综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14730v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：视觉生成式人工智能的快速发展带来了广泛的知识产权风险，涵盖对受保护数据和模型资产的未经授权学习、复制、提取、滥用和再分发。为应对这些风险，越来越多的技术防御措施被提出。然而，现有综述通常按生命周期阶段或技术机制组织相关文献，这可能掩盖不同方法的保护意图。本综述提出了一个用于视觉生成模型中知识产权保护的二维分类法。主轴是控制逻辑视图，根据其调节的风险变量将方法分为信息暴露控制、生成行为约束和归因与问责。次轴将数据知识产权和模型知识产权区分为跨领域的资产维度。在此框架下，我们系统地回顾了保护方法，并校准了评估标准。
tldr: 本文提出了一种二维分类法，从控制逻辑视图和资产维度两个角度系统梳理视觉生成式人工智能中的知识产权保护方法，以更清晰地揭示不同技术的保护意图。
en_tdlr: This survey proposes a two-dimensional taxonomy, systematically reviewing IP protection methods in visual generative AI from control logic and asset dimensions to better clarify the protective intent of different techniques.
